reviews.text: Our 50 plus year old pool looks excellent after a Texas Express pool remodel this summer.  Every team of men from tear out to tiling to re-plastering were masters of their crafts, efficient and polite.  Irwin and Brandon were easy to work with and responsive.  We highly recommend them for your pool work.

I must say, I'm extremely happy that I went with Texas Express.  Irwin has been the best person to work with. Irwin and his team did a great job on our pool. We had it resurfaced, which included pulling off the old plaster as well. His leak detection team repaired a leak through our deck as well.

Entire process took right around a month to complete.

Thank you for a job well done.

Texas Express Pool Remodeling LLC Is the best pool company I have experienced.

I had several pool companies come to the house and give quotes. My pool was installed in the late 80s and had never been serviced like this. Hands down Texas Express Pool Remodeling was the best 1 that came out. They know their stuff and have helped me out with getting the pool replastered, new jets, new light and a new pump system. All done at a very great price.. Highly recommend this pool company. Thank you Texas Express Pool Remodeling!

Texas Express Pool Remodeling resurfaced our pool and spa and did an excellent job in quick timing for a reasonable price. The work was completed in the height of summer, and we did not have to wait to be serviced - many other companies we contacted for quotes could not get to our project for weeks, sometimes months. Irwin's team arrived on schedule and completed the job faster than expected.

From day one Irwin had this great “can do” attitude and listened to what I wanted in my new pool. I would like to express our gratitude to Irwin and the entire team at Texas Express Pools. Their level of service is unmatchable in the state of Texas! With Irwin’s no pressure, but honest and at times witty input, we were able to make decisions regarding the reconstruction of our pool, spa and fire pit that were delivered as promised. If this had been a home renovation it would have been called an entire “gut job”.  Irwin was awesome to work with, always taking our phone calls and updating us.

Just had Irwin and his team do some tile replacement and was extremely pleased with the work.  They were able to find a tile that very closely matched my existing ones when another company told me they couldn't do it.
The team did an excellant job and cleaned up the work area nicely.
Fair price and great quality work.  You can't go wrong with that.
Texas Express did a great job resurfacing my pool and adding a much needed handrail. I would recommend them for any pool resurfacing.

They did an fantastic job plastering my family’s pool. Their price is really the best around, so there was no need to negotiate on cost. they did a fast and very clean job. I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking to remodel their pool. Everything was completed on time. They were really professional.

I would highly recommend Irwin and his team, they retained an open line of communication to make sure the process went as stress-free as possible.  They were very receptive to any of my concerns and made sure the work was done just the way I desired. The team did a good job of cleaning up the work area each day when they were complete.  They are very skilled, honest and hardworking team with the best value in town!!  THANK YOU.

Irwin and his team were great to work with.  He was quick to respond to our thousands of questions and the entire process was completed very quickly.  The new tile and plaster look amazing, it’s like a brand new pool.

He has been a great joy to work with Irwin and his staff. From start to finish the communication was great. Irwin inform me step-by-step on pricing and progress and when they would be here, it was great. My over all experience with Texas express has been great!!!! I recommend them to anybody.

Thanks again to Irwin and the entire crew!!

I had a very good experience with this pool company. I had them plaster my pool, redo my rock wall to a stone wall with 3 water features, small Oklahoma patio and a sweet outdoor kitchen. The mason they have is unbelievable. The owner is great and takes care of any problems and his bid was extremely fair. All in all I recommend this company hands down.

Irwin and his crew do top notch, quality work, and at a fair price. They were very responsive to any of my concerns and made sure that the work was done to my specifications. Very professional, hard working crew!! I recommend them very highly!

I've personally worked with Irwin and Brandon on jobs in the past and they are dedicated to their work and make sure customers needs are met in a timely manner. I recommend them for any pool remodel needs.

I had Texas Express replace all the perimeter tiles on my pool and spa due to cracking and damage from the winter freeze. Excellent work, very fast and very reasonable. Good Communications throughout. Highly recommend.

After a few quotes to remodel my pool, I couldn’t be any more pleased to work with Texas express pools, Brandon and Irwin answered all my questions without hesitation and made the whole process a breeze. These guys are my go to from here on out!
Irwin and his crew  were excellent to work with. They showed up on time, were very professional and did and excellent job remolding our pool. I would highly recommend them.

Awesome service. Very communicative. Made sure the job was completed properly, each day, each step of the way. Offered extremely competitive pricing for a complete resurface. Ensured all equipment was working properly multiple days even after job was completed. Highly recommend.

Great customer service!!! They replaced  the coping around my pool and did such a good job we had them come back and replace the grout around our pool. They pay attention to the little details. I would highly recommend them!
Great team to work with.  Quality work, super nice people, attention to detail.  My pool was a mess before and now it is amazing.
Irwin and his team were super responsive and the quality of their work was excellent. Very professional. I would highly recommend them.

They did an excellent job on my pool. I would highly recommend this company. They really know what they are doing!!
